responses: You can get a library card by submitting your student ID at the library counter. Students can borrow up to 3 books for 14 days, renewable once.

last date to register for courses
where do i register for classes
responses: You can register for courses through the student portal under Course Registration.

patterns: where can i find the timetable
responses: Your class timetable is available on the student portal under Academics > Timetable.

patterns: where can i find the syllabus
what is covered in this subject
responses: The syllabus for each course is available under Academics > Syllabus on the student portal.

patterns: how do i check my attendance
am i eligible for exams based on attendance
how to apply for attendance condonation
responses: You can check your attendance percentage on the student portal under Academics > Attendance. A minimum of 75% attendance is required to be eligible for exams.

patterns: when does the semester exam start
responses: The exam schedule is published on the student portal under Examinations > Date Sheet at least two weeks before exams begin.

patterns: where can i check my exam results
how do i see my grades
responses: Exam results are published on the student results portal under the Examinations tab.

patterns: how do i apply for revaluation
how to request re-evaluation of marks
responses: You can apply for revaluation through the student portal under Examinations > Revaluation within 15 days of result declaration, subject to the applicable fee.

patterns: how do i apply for admission
responses: Admission details, eligibility criteria, and application deadlines are listed on the college website under Admissions.

patterns: what is the fee payment deadline
how do i pay my fees
how can i pay semester fees
responses: Fee payment deadlines are announced each semester on the notice board and student portal. Fees can be paid online through the Student Portal > Fee Payment section.

patterns: how much are the semester fees
responses: The detailed fee structure for each program is available on the college website under Admissions > Fee Structure.

patterns: am i eligible for a scholarship
how to apply for financial aid
how much scholarship can i get
responses: Scholarship eligibility and application details are listed on the college website under Student Services > Scholarships.

patterns: how do i reset my student portal password
i am locked out of my account
responses: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and follow the email verification steps to reset your password.

patterns: how do i connect to campus wifi
how to get internet access on campus
responses: Connect to the 'Campus-WiFi' network and log in using your student portal credentials. Contact IT support if you face connectivity issues.

patterns: how do i get my id card
when will i receive my id card
responses: You can request a new or duplicate ID card by submitting an application at the Administration Office along with the applicable fee.

patterns: how do i apply for hostel
how to get a hostel room
responses: Hostel accommodation applications are submitted through the Student Portal > Hostel Services. Allotment is based on availability and distance from home.

patterns: is there a college bus service
how do i get a bus pass
responses: College bus routes, timings, and pass application details are available under Student Services > Transport.

patterns: how do i register for placements
responses: Placement drives and registration details are shared by the Training & Placement Cell via the student portal and college notice board.

patterns: how do i contact my professor
responses: Faculty contact details and office hours are listed on the college website under Departments > Faculty.

patterns: how do i get a bonafide certificate
how to apply for a migration certificate
responses: Certificate requests (bonafide, transcript, migration, character) can be submitted through the Student Portal > Certificate Requests section.

patterns: how do i apply for leave
responses: Leave applications can be submitted through the Student Portal > Leave Request, along with supporting documents if applicable.

patterns: what time does the canteen open
responses: The college canteen is open from 8 AM to 6 PM on all working days.

patterns: how do i join the sports club
responses: The college offers a gymnasium, indoor games room, and outdoor sports grounds. Contact the Sports Office to join a club or book facilities.
